name: @teactjs/telegram
description: Telegram platform adapter for Teact — framework-agnostic (zero-dep fetch driver, plus grammY and GramIO drivers)

scripts.build: bun build ./src/index.ts ./src/grammy.ts ./src/gramio.ts --outdir ./dist --format esm --target node --splitting --external react --external react/jsx-runtime --external react/jsx-dev-runtime --external @teactjs/core --external grammy --external gramio && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly --outDir dist --declaration --project tsconfig.build.json
